source_notes: GEM FIDYear=2025 reflected a Nov-2024 Reuters report that Petrosen expected FID in 2025. Following Kosmos Energy's withdrawal (joint withdrawal agreement announced 23 Apr 2026, no compensation; license to be reassigned exclusively to Petrosen subject to ministerial decree), Petrosen now targets FID for 2026. Two independent off-GEM sources corroborate: MSGBC (4 May 2026: 'Petrosen is working toward a 2026 FID' / 'a final investment decision targeted for 2026') and Ecofin Agency (Petrosen CEO Alioune Guèye: 'a final investment decision expected in December'). Widely reported as a December 2026 deadline. FIDStatus remains Pre-FID. Yellow: target/deadline via reported official statements, not a regulatory FID filing; date could slip. (Note: financialafrik.com source from prior draft dropped — returned HTTP 000 on verification.)

GEM LatestPlannedStartYear=2026 is no longer attainable: FID is not expected until 2026, so a 2026 start is impossible. Post-Kosmos-exit, first gas is targeted for 2028-2029. Two independent off-GEM sources corroborate: MSGBC (4 May 2026: 'first gas expected between 2028 and 2029') and Ecofin Agency (Petrosen CEO: 'first production could begin between late 2028 and early 2029'); the recurring specific figure across reporting is 'first gas January 2029'. Set latest planned start to 2029. OriginalPlannedStartYear (2026) left unchanged as the original plan. Yellow: target via reported officials for a pre-FID deepwater project; likely to move further.
scope_note: Single-unit project; field is project-level. Existing StartDate [ref] (IISD) retained; MSGBC + Ecofin sources for the revised year.
